One digital system for O&M

An end-to-end solution that covers the whole inspection cycle. This is not just a drone and not a standalone piece of software — it is a single operating system for running solar assets.

AI Platform

Maintenance

04 / Digital twin

Digital groundwork: accuracy down to 5 centimetres

01LiDAR and photogrammetry: a digital twin built to ±5 cm.
023D modelling: an exact copy of the terrain and the plant's structures.
03Insolation analysis: irradiance and shading zones calculated.
04Layout modelling: panel placement optimised for maximum output.

06 / Flights

Multi-level navigation
and flight safety

01Automatic planning: routes built from the 3D model (point cloud) and camera parameters.

08 / Defects

The defects we detect

The system is built around real operating scenarios and automatically flags the most critical defect types. The analysis relies on visible light, infrared, image fusion and AI models.

Hot spotsCell overheating / Thermal imaging
Hidden cracksHidden microcracks / Electroluminescence
Black spotsModule degradation / Visual + AI
DustSurface soiling / Visual detection
Sand burialSand accumulation / RGB analysis
Snow coverSnow cover / Visual + Thermal
VegetationShading by trees / 3D mapping
Panel damageMechanical damage / Visual inspection
Current anomaliesElectrical deviations / Multi-sensor fusion
11+ defect types
95%+ AI accuracy
Under 2 minutes to analyse

09 / Process

How the system works

From the survey flight to the repair

The system builds the inspection route, the drone flies it autonomously, the platform analyses the data, identifies defects, plots them on the map, generates a report, creates tasks and tracks resolution. Repair results flow back into the system and become part of the asset's history.

Step 1PlanningRoute and mission parameters
Step 2Survey flightAutonomous data capture
Step 3AI analysisDefect recognition
Step 4VisualisationDefect map and report
Step 5O&MTasks and control
Cycle time: from the flight to a closed task — 24–72 hours
Integration: all data is synchronised in one platform
History: a full record of changes and repairs on the asset

11 / O&M workflow

From pixel to repair: the O&M workflow

Step 1: Detection

The AI finds the defect and assigns it a priority.

Step 2: Task automation

The platform generates a work order with exact GPS coordinates and the type of problem.

Step 3: Crew routing

The engineer receives the task with a route already planned, and closes it with a photo report.
